title: Inference Provider Trustworthiness Index & Adoption Pathways
creator: Ava Johnson
description: Create a reproducible Trustworthiness Index for inference providers and map recommended adoption pathways per buyer persona. The index blends objective telemetry (latency/SLO variance, model freshness, quantization compatibility, hardware affinity), product controls (rollout/canary presence, fallback variants, KMS integrations), and commercial signals (pricing transparency, reserved capacity options). Deliver an adoption playbook tying index tiers to recommended procurement/rollout steps for SMB, mid-market, and enterprise buyers.
goals: Define a lightweight, repeatable scoring rubric for inference provider trustworthiness
Produce a ranked catalog of top 12 providers by index score and annotate strengths/weaknesses
Create buyer-facing adoption pathways (SMB, Mid-market, Enterprise) with recommended guardrails
Prototype a dashboard view in Console mock that surfaces index and quick-wins for customers
success_metrics: Index rubric validated by at least 5 enterprise procurement interviews
Top-12 provider catalog completed and reproducible with data sources documented
Playbook reduces average vendor evaluation time in pilot accounts by 30%
Dashboard prototype demoed to Sales and Product with positive signal from >70% stakeholders
deliverables: Trustworthiness Index spec (scoring factors, weighting, data sources)
Provider catalog CSV + annotated notes (top 12, regional variants)
Buyer adoption playbook PDF with checklists and rollout templates
Console dashboard mock and clickthrough Figma
Research appendix: interview notes and vendor responses
tasks: Inventory candidate scoring signals (telemetry, contractual, technical compatibility) — PM lead
Define weighting scheme and sanity-check on historical outages — PM + Research
Automate data pulls for latency/SLO variance from existing benchmarks — Eng ask (ENG-1842)
Run qualitative interviews with 6 procurement leads across finance and platform teams
Map common procurement triggers to recommended index thresholds (e.g., SLA required -> Tier A)
Design Console mock and hand off to Design for Figma prototype
Draft playbook and review with Solutions and Sales for pilot applicability
Finalize catalog and publish internal doc + share for pilot with 3 customers
timeline: 2026-04-15: Finalize materials and distribute to pilot sales teams
risks: Signal coverage gaps (some providers do not expose necessary metrics)
Weighting bias: rubric may over-index latency vs. contractual risk
Customer procurement variation: playbook must accommodate legal/industry exceptions
Data freshness: catalog can become stale quickly without an automated refresh cadence
notes: Prefer pragmatic, easy-to-communicate signals initially (latency/SLO variance, reserved capacity offerings, KMS support). We will iterate the weighting after the pilot. Aim to keep the public-facing buyer playbook concise (2–3 pages) and the technical appendix internal. Coordinate with Sales to pick 3 pilot accounts representing each buyer persona.
